source: Elite Obsolete Electronics (eoe.works), collection: iPod Classic 6th & 7th Generation Replacement Parts A1238, surveyed 2026-09-13
notes: Hex values are approximations chosen from the product names for on-screen rendering; they are not vendor-supplied.

Prices are the lowest listed variant. Faceplates and click wheels are usually cheaper without the bundled center button; backplates are cheaper without the pre-installed headphone jack and dock bezel.
Metal faceplates take metal center buttons; plastic and transparent faceplates take plastic or crystal clear center buttons.
Every backplate color is sold in both Thin and Thick; thick adds about $3 on some colors.
Search URL is used for the link because product handles were not captured for every item.
